segments.t: On the sidewalk outside the comedy club, Gabriel tries to hail a taxi to take his stressed actress home. Instead, Sandrine spots a parked electric scooter and decides to make a reckless midnight getaway through the streets of Paris. Let's listen to their chaotic exchange in French first.
Le taxi arrive dans deux minutes.
Regarde ces trottinettes électriques là-bas!
Ne t'approche pas de ces engins.
Elles ont l'air tellement amusantes!
C'est bien trop dangereux la nuit.
C'est le moyen parfait pour rentrer.
Tu n'as même pas de casque!
Je sais parfaitement conduire ce soir.
S'il te plaît, monte dans la voiture.
Je veux sentir le vent frais.
Sandrine, descends immédiatement de là!
Attrape-moi si tu peux, mon cher!
Non, non, non, reviens ici!
À demain matin à l'agence!
Let's examine the conversation line by line and explore the French expressions.
Le taxi arrive dans deux minutes.
'The taxi is arriving in two minutes.' Gabriel checks his phone for the car's arrival.
Regarde ces trottinettes électriques là-bas!
'Look at those electric scooters over there!' Sandrine's eyes light up with sudden mischief.
Ne t'approche pas de ces engins.
'Do not go near those contraptions.' Gabriel immediately senses trouble.
Elles ont l'air tellement amusantes!
'They look so much fun!' Sandrine steps toward the parked two-wheelers.
C'est bien trop dangereux la nuit.
'It is far too dangerous at night.' Gabriel pleads with common sense.
C'est le moyen parfait pour rentrer.
'It is the perfect way to get home.' Sandrine unlocks a scooter with her smartphone.
Tu n'as même pas de casque!
'You do not even have a helmet!' Gabriel highlights the total lack of protection.
Je sais parfaitement conduire ce soir.
'I know how to drive perfectly tonight.' Sandrine steps confidently onto the platform.
S'il te plaît, monte dans la voiture.
'Please get into the car.' Gabriel gestures toward the approaching cab.
Je veux sentir le vent frais.
'I want to feel the fresh wind.' Sandrine savors the evening breeze on her face.
Sandrine, descends immédiatement de là!
'Sandrine, get down from there immediately!' Gabriel rushes forward to grab the handlebars.
Attrape-moi si tu peux, mon cher!
'Catch me if you can, my dear!' Sandrine squeezes the throttle and glides away.
Non, non, non, reviens ici!
'No, no, no, come back here!' Gabriel shouts as he watches her zip down the boulevard.
À demain matin à l'agence!
'See you tomorrow morning at the agency!' Sandrine's voice echoes down the dark Parisian street. Now let's listen to the complete discussion once more to reinforce the vocabulary.

Gabriel watches Sandrine disappear down the avenue on her scooter, shaking his head in amused disbelief. When you watch the episode, listen out for the expressions meaning 'arrives' and 'minutes'. You'll catch them now. See you next time!
Bonne soirée!
